FM.description: Same sentence, different formatting (inside a paragraph, bold, wikilink, heading, nested bullet)

HW.description: Sentence hard-wrapped over two lines (Stage 1 treats every line as its own note)

NR.description: Near-copy: typo, spelling, word order, punctuation

FR.description: English sentence and its French version

CW.description: Plain word vs code word (porn/corn, alcohol/sauce, ...)

SM.description: One sentence summarising several bullets elsewhere

ST.description: Parser stress: bullet glued to ---, mid-bullet sentence, e.g./Dr., checkbox, nesting, run-on

MS.description: Sloppy rewording: lowercase, abbreviations, typos, symbols

LN.description: Thought sitting in a run of loose lines (no bullets, no blank lines, no full stops)

NF.description: Same template, different day or event

CF.description: Same statement with a changed value (conflicting versions, worth a look)
